 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 15-07-2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner who is husband of opposite party No. 2 apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 504, 506, 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner offers and undertakes that he is ready to give maintenance amount of Rs. 5000/- per month, starting from this month, to opposite party No. 2.
4.

In view of the undertaking of learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is ready to give maintenance amount of Rs. 5000/- (five thousand) per month to the opposite Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.41337 of 2024(2) dt.15-07-2024 party No. 2, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, let the above-named petitioner be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-III, West Champaran, Bettiah in connection with Manpur P. S.
